answer: Sybil resistance here rests on staked attribution rather than bare identity claims. Every agent must lock a bond before its votes count, and the chain weights influence along a ridge of historical uptime, so a fresh cluster of wallets starts near zero. Launching a thousand puppets means posting a thousand bonds, each slashed when the cluster's internal pulse of attestations looks circular. Capital as solid as basalt, not cheap handles, becomes the real price of entry.
